intro.title: Build typed URL params parser
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a typed URL parameters parser in TypeScript. You will learn how to extract query parameters from a URL string and convert them into a structured, type-safe object. The core concept involves using TypeScript's type system to define the expected shape of the parameters and ensure type safety. You will work with built-in JavaScript Web APIs like URL and URLSearchParams to parse the URL. By the end, you'll have a reusable function that validates and returns typed parameters, enhancing code reliability and developer experience.
intro.usecase: In real applications, typed URL parameter parsing is essential for building robust filtering systems in dashboards and data tables. For example, an e-commerce product listing page might use URL parameters like `?category=electronics&priceRange=100-500&sort=rating` to maintain filter state across page refreshes or when sharing links. This pattern also appears in analytics dashboards where users can save and share specific chart configurations through URL parameters. As a developer, implementing type-safe URL parsing ensures that your application correctly handles user inputs and prevents runtime errors from malformed parameters.
